# Vendored Anatomy subset

Upstream: https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy

Revision: `e9488296a44211c42701ff71705b7901470ec78f`

License: MIT, reproduced in LICENSE. Source files are unmodified copies.

The core geometry kit and its audit dependencies are kept here so the illustration can be rebuilt without an npm install. `verify/` contains the upstream screenshot, browser driving and line-check utilities. The rest of Anatomy, its examples and repository history are not bundled.
